name: Agri-Input Distributors and Dealers

seo.title: Claim Recovery for Agri-Input Distributors | VipraTech
seo.description: For distributors of seeds, fertilisers and crop protection: track every claim on every company, match credit notes and ledgers, and recover what is owed.

hero.headline: Know what every company owes you, and get it paid before the claim window closes
hero.subheadline: Agri-input distributors carry many companies at once. VipraTech gives you one register of every claim, credit note and ledger difference across all of them.

intro: A distributor of seeds, fertilisers and crop protection products may carry ten or more companies, each with its own schemes, return rules, cash discounts and claim formats. Season-end returns, scheme payouts, rate differences and discounts owed by companies are a large part of the distributor's margin, and much of it is settled late, short or not at all.

challenges.title: Claims spread across companies
challenges.detail: Each company has its own format, portal and timeline, so nobody knows the total owed at any time.

challenges.title: Credit notes without a breakdown
challenges.detail: Companies issue lump-sum credit notes that cover several claims and short-pay some lines without saying which.

challenges.title: Returns and schemes netted against you
challenges.detail: When stock goes back at season end, companies reverse schemes and discounts, sometimes more than they should.

challenges.title: Retailer credit on your side
challenges.detail: You give retailers credit and discounts too, and the gap between what you pay and what you recover grows every season.

use_cases.note: One register of claims on every company, matched to credit notes and ledgers, with follow-up packs for what is short or pending.
Company credit notes and debit notes matched to your claims and returns, and your books agreed with each company's ledger.
Your season-end returns to each company, with the schemes and discounts they reverse checked against their own policy.
Volume and growth schemes from companies calculated from your purchases, so no slab you reached goes unpaid.
Cash discounts you earn from companies and give to retailers, both checked against payment dates and slabs.
Price-drop compensation on stock you held on the date, calculated from your own purchases and sales.

documents: Company credit notes, debit notes and statements
Company ledgers and your own books
systems: Tally, Busy or Marg for your books

facts.text: Agrochemical companies typically give dealers around three months of credit, so claims and collections often run months behind sales.

faqs.q: We use Tally. Does that work?
faqs.a: Yes. Tally exports are read for your books, and claim sheets and credit notes in whatever format each company sends.

faqs.q: Can it handle ten or more companies?
faqs.a: Yes. Each company's formats and rules are set up once, and every claim sits in one register.

faqs.q: Is this for distributors or for companies?
faqs.a: This page is for distributors and dealers. Companies use the same engine to check the claims distributors raise.
